## Definition of Done (report §9.2)

- [ ] Requirement / acceptance criterion traced
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / property / integration as appropriate), incl. error and retry cases
- [ ] Data model, policy and privacy handling documented if affected
- [ ] No personal data in logs, fixtures or prompts; telemetry redacted
- [ ] Known limits and fallbacks stated
- [ ] ADR / threat model / risk register updated if a decision or risk changed
- [ ] `ci-local` is green on the final tree
- [ ] Commits are signed and carry `Signed-off-by` (`git commit -s`)
